title: Disney accelerator brain-controlled rock 'Rocky'

tellings.quote: So, I worked with them and in the lab we invented a rock that you could move with your mind

plain: Around 2020, in a lab run by Disney's accelerator, a programme that helps young companies, a team built a rock nicknamed Rocky that you could move with your mind, says Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency. He says he worked there himself and that "in the lab we invented a rock that you could move with your mind".
